scope: Actual Force drains and Surprise Assault/Counter Assault play. Observes completed draws/total, Force loss and source cleanup: each side wins/ties/loses, empty/partial Reserve, own drain cancellation. Frozen-power test deliberately moves both opposing characters to Lost after first draw completion as a fixture intervention, not a claimed supported card effect. No GEMP production source modified.
references: AR Appendix B pp140–141 Counter Assault freezes power and draw count at start of resolution; p153 Surprise Assault points to same ruling
